'''ZK-517P''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], that was designated as the command unit for the [[Voss shield bunker|shield bunker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that supported the Eternal Empire's [[Voss Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] in orbit.<ref name="Destroy" /> Around [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> ZK-517P was destroyed by [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Rokuss]], who invaded the bunker and destroyed it with explosives.<ref name="Destroy" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZK-517P was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a 2015 Digital Expansion.<ref name="Destroy" />
